_comment: Expert registry. Three categories: 'super' agents are jobs (Consultant, Lawyer, Engineer…) — their `label` IS the role, designed for productivity gains on existing tasks. 'genius' agents are historical figures unlocking creative or service outputs the user couldn't produce alone (DaVinci builds visual universes, Wolfgang composes music, Alfred runs your Mac as your majordome, Socrates interviews you to draft new experts) — their `label` is the genius's name. 'coach' agents help you grow in a life domain (diet, learning, sport, cooking) — their `label` is 'X Coach'. Sub-fields: `role` (optional subtitle for tooltips), `kind` (informational taxonomy), `category` (drives roster UX), `skills` (mounted SKILLs — a name not yet vendored under skills/<name>/SKILL.md is silently skipped). The slug (key) is the stable identifier used in personas/skills and never changes. User-created custom experts live in <VAR_DIR>/experts/<slug>.{md,json}.
